description: Use for QuickBooks questions like "how did we do last month in QuickBooks", "why did profit drop in QuickBooks", "what moved on our QuickBooks P&L", "why are costs up this month", "what's our gross margin in QuickBooks", "how does this month compare to last year", or a monthly P&L read from QuickBooks — even when the user never says "P&L".
